mother_loss.world_elimination: cancel sanctuary jobs, ritual and Unicorn state; no world refund or transfer

pyramid.open_timeout_rule: OPEN remains active until an eligible Structured Alliance completes 168 continuous hours of control.

guardian_sampling.population: active, non-eliminated Players ranked by development_score
guardian_sampling.if_fewer_than_10: Use all available active non-eliminated Players.
guardian_sampling.reference_modifiers: counter=1.0, no research, no terrain, no walls, no RNG

reward_membership_snapshot.alliance_dissolution: Snapshot members keep personal/economic reward for remaining 14d; Alliance title archived.

pyramid.cycle_anchor_rule: All state deadlines derive from persisted scheduled_at timestamps; delayed worker execution never drifts the 14d + 30d calendar.

garrison_lifecycle.on_owner_change: winning surviving troops become initial Pyramid garrison
garrison_lifecycle.allied_reinforcement: real marches allowed up to 1,000,000 alliance-wide units
garrison_lifecycle.on_reward_lock: all living Pyramid garrison troops return by real marches to valid own settlements
garrison_lifecycle.new_open: new neutral Guardian snapshot and garrison are created

reservation.acquire: Atomically at launch of a PvP CONQUEST march containing an eligible Conquest Cart when owner-change eligibility could consume a settlement slot.
reservation.success_transition: On owner-change commit, reservation is consumed and atomically becomes owned-settlement count.

architecture.realtime: Realtime socket/SSE push; persistent database is source of truth
architecture.slot_claim: World player-slot claim is atomic; concurrent joins cannot occupy the same prevalidated slot or exceed 100.

naval_surveillance.rule: Transport ships are logistics only. They do not create a combat roster, do not receive casualties, and do not generate passive territorial detection alerts.

research_scope.economy_construction_effects: Apply only to the settlement that completed the research.
research_scope.recruitment_effects: Apply to recruitment jobs started in that settlement and are snapshotted at job start.
research_scope.outgoing_march_effects: Origin settlement research profile is snapshotted at launch for that march.
research_scope.own_garrison_defense: Uses current defending-settlement research at battle snapshot.
research_scope.allied_reinforcement_defense: Uses the reinforcement research snapshot captured when that reinforcement march launched.
research_scope.own_troops_rehomed: After a completed transfer to another own settlement, future actions use the new origin settlement research; research is not permanently attached to unit instances.
research_scope.mother_succession: All research of surviving settlements remains unchanged. Research in the conquered Mother follows normal 85% settlement research retention and is not copied to the successor.

recruitment.standard_training_throughput_formula: effective_time = max(1s, base_time * building_time_multiplier / (1 + training_research_bonus + pyramid_training_bonus))
recruitment.legendary_time_rule: Drago/Angelo/Demone each require exactly 14 days and are not modified by generic training research, Pyramid training bonus or Rubies.
recruitment.mythic_sanctuary_upgrade_queue: Uses one of the two construction queues of the current Mother settlement.
recruitment.unicorn_ritual_queue: One player-wide mythic ritual slot; 7 days fixed; not modified by construction/training/research/Pyramid/Rubies.

modifier_algebra.same_metric_rule: Percentage bonuses/debuffs inside the same named category add first, then the category hard cap is applied.
modifier_algebra.independent_categories_rule: Independent categories multiply in the frozen order; no silent compounding inside a category.
modifier_algebra.time_reduction_rule: Add same-category reductions, clamp to the declared cap, then multiply base duration by (1-reduction). Throughput bonuses use division by (1+throughput_bonus).
modifier_algebra.production_rule: Add production percentage bonuses, clamp to +60% permanent/global cap where applicable, then multiply base production.

legendary_stacking.base_stats: Every legendary unit present contributes its own unit stats to power.
legendary_stacking.march_limit: Maximum 1 legendary of any type per outgoing march.
legendary_stacking.angel: 15% casualty reduction applies once per side; all loss-reduction sources remain subject to global 25% cap.
legendary_stacking.demon: -12% DEF/-8% ATK applies once per side; category debuff cap remains -25%.
legendary_stacking.dragon: The +30% vs Beasts is self-modifier on each Dragon; wall_damage applies only when that Dragon is on attacking side.

neutral_conversion.neutral_to_player: Autonomous neutral growth stops immediately on ownership transfer.

player_to_neutral_on_inactivity.research: Freeze the settlement-local research state; no neutral research jobs run. It remains attached to the settlement for future conquest/retention logic.
player_to_neutral_on_inactivity.future_growth: Resume deterministic neutral ticks only when current level is below the current WorldAge cap.
player_to_neutral_on_inactivity.wall_after_conversion: current wall HP preserved immediately; next 72h neutral tick restores walls to maxHP

missions.reward_storage_rule: Resource-equivalent rewards respect the target settlement Warehouse hard cap; overflow is discarded and logged, never stored outside cap.
missions.origin_conquered_while_active: mission continues; completion returns troops/reward to current Mother, else nearest own settlement; if player eliminated, no reward and troops disbanded

requirements.contribution_definition: member has at least one valid CONQUEST assault that either wins combat or reduces target loyalty

missions.catalog_authority: Structured catalog is runtime authority; narrative names in PDF are display semantics.

achievements.rule: Each threshold unlocks a permanent world-scoped heraldic decoration/title tier; no combat/economy modifier.

spec_contract.numeric_conflict_rule: JSON exact integer/decimal values govern runtime. Markdown tables are human-readable views only.
spec_contract.machine_runtime_rule: Every competitive numeric modifier, threshold, cap, speed, timer, unlock gate, mission reward, combat coefficient and state transition parameter must be read from structured JSON or generated constants derived from it. Do not parse numeric gameplay values from prose.
spec_contract.spec_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with spec_contract.spec_hash omitted; sort_keys=true; separators=(comma,colon); ensure_ascii=false.

wall_repair.reference_for_level_ge_2: derived from Mura level-2 base by the common construction curve for the current wall level
wall_repair.manual_overlap_rule: manual job heals the snapshotted HP amount at completion, clamped to current max_hp; auto-repaired overlap is not refunded

raid.credit_timing: on successful return to a valid own settlement
raid.origin_lost_on_return: reroute to current Mother, else nearest own settlement; if eliminated, loot is lost

caravans.search_visibility_rule: Only hostile/non-allied OUTBOUND caravans whose current route position is inside effective search radius may be returned; cargo amount remains undisclosed until permitted by intelligence rules.

intelligence_engine.error_application: deterministic band centered on true value; UI never fabricates a false direction, category or mission family

wall_static_casualty_allocation.overkill_reflow: repeat proportional allocation over remaining living stacks until pool exhausted or no living units
wall_static_casualty_allocation.reason: static wall damage resolves casualties, not persistent per-unit wound state

retention.building_level: floor(old_building_level*0.85), then clamp to retained settlement level
retention.building_prerequisite_loss: FROZEN_LOCKED until both settlement-level and research prerequisites are restored
retention.research: retain floor(85% of completed local research levels) by pruning deepest/most advanced nodes first while preserving a valid prerequisite DAG
retention.resources: floor(resource*0.85), then clamp each resource to the new effective Warehouse capacity; overflow discarded and audited
retention.wall_hp: new_max_hp from retained wall level; current_hp=min(pre_conquest_current_hp,new_max_hp), followed by post-conquest auto-repair

mercenary_contract.client_alliance_dissolves: contract_continues_against_target; escrow remains locked; provider can complete normally

mother_transition.return_destination_if_player_survives: new Mother, else nearest own settlement
mother_transition.if_player_eliminated: remaining units are disbanded at action resolution

inactivity_transition.inflight_hostile_arrival_after_conversio: revalidate new owner and legality; becomes PvE if still legally hostile, else mission invalidates/returns
inactivity_transition.timeout_rule: At 120 continuous days of inactivity, execute player-to-neutral conversion idempotently.

state_transition_closures.title: PDF/JSON authority
state_transition_closures.rule: Bible provides semantics/invariants; CANONICAL_SPEC provides exact runtime numbers. Same version and spec_hash are mandatory; any divergence blocks the build.

state_transition_closures.title: Wall repair at level 1
state_transition_closures.rule: Mura L1 manual-repair reference is 60% of Mura L2 base: G240/W480/C540/I300/Au30 and 36 minutes.

state_transition_closures.title: Damaged wall upgrade
state_transition_closures.rule: Wall upgrade never heals for free; absolute missing HP is preserved across the upgrade.

state_transition_closures.title: Manual plus automatic wall repair
state_transition_closures.rule: Both may overlap; manual job snapshots the selected missing HP and any auto-repaired overlap receives no refund.

state_transition_closures.title: Wall repair research
state_transition_closures.rule: Each level of Wall Repair I/II gives +5% manual-repair throughput; cumulative max +50%; time is ceil(base/(1+bonus)).

state_transition_closures.title: Building unlock gates
state_transition_closures.rule: A later-unlocked building requires both its settlement-level gate and its research gate; losing either leaves a retained building FROZEN_LOCKED.

state_transition_closures.title: Raid loot
state_transition_closures.rule: Only RAID steals resources; survivor cargo plus loot-capacity research caps loot; resources are distributed proportionally with deterministic largest remainder.

state_transition_closures.title: Caravan model
state_transition_closures.rule: Caravans are abstract logistic slots, not recruitable unit entities.

state_transition_closures.title: Caravan interception
state_transition_closures.rule: Target a detected caravan; server chooses first reachable intercept point; if none before delivery, reject; normal combat determines escort/interceptor outcome.

state_transition_closures.title: Diagonal corner cutting
state_transition_closures.rule: Land and naval pathfinding forbid diagonal corner cutting through two impassable adjacent cardinals.

state_transition_closures.title: Naval assault and Sentinels
state_transition_closures.rule: Port-to-Port naval assault bypasses terrestrial sentinel path; no water surveillance in v3.7.

state_transition_closures.title: Ship survival and invalid arrival
state_transition_closures.rule: Transport ships never die from terrestrial combat; if troops all die they return empty; invalid destination before disembark triggers turnaround without battle.

state_transition_closures.title: Zero power and exact tie
state_transition_closures.rule: No attackers after wall phase means defense wins; zero defender troops with surviving attackers means attacker wins; exact power tie is defender victory.

state_transition_closures.title: Noncombat units alone
state_transition_closures.rule: ATTACK/RAID/CONQUEST must contain at least one unit with ATK>0; Cart and Falcon cannot initiate battle alone.

state_transition_closures.title: Wall static casualties
state_transition_closures.rule: Wall static-damage pool is distributed deterministically by surviving unit counts; kills use effective HP and overkill is reflowed until pool exhaustion.

state_transition_closures.title: Counter matrix
state_transition_closures.rule: Counter matrix is explicit in CANONICAL_SPEC with default 1.00 and all current canonical exceptions, including Beasts categories.

state_transition_closures.title: Loyalty after owner change
state_transition_closures.rule: Any owner change, including Unicorn, resets settlement Loyalty to 100 and closes prior loyalty campaigns.

state_transition_closures.title: Cart reservation terminal release
state_transition_closures.rule: A conquest reservation releases on every terminal march state without owner change, including victory with Loyalty still above zero.

state_transition_closures.title: Unicorn cap20 concurrency
state_transition_closures.rule: Unicorn acquires a cap20 reservation atomically before battle; failure to reserve means no battle and Unicorn is not consumed.

state_transition_closures.title: Retention below unlock prerequisites
state_transition_closures.rule: Retained buildings that no longer meet settlement/research gates remain preserved but FROZEN_LOCKED with no effect until prerequisites return.

state_transition_closures.title: Retention resources vs Warehouse
state_transition_closures.rule: After 85% retention, each resource is clamped to new effective Warehouse capacity; overflow is discarded and audited.

state_transition_closures.title: Sentinels after conquest
state_transition_closures.rule: Surviving Sentinel structures transfer empty to new owner; surviving prior/ally garrisons return by real marches; territory recalculates atomically.

state_transition_closures.title: Unused Player-slot reserve
state_transition_closures.rule: Unclaimed player anchors keep a Chebyshev-radius-4 reservation blocking territory/founding until claimed or World admission closes.

state_transition_closures.title: Spawn playability
state_transition_closures.rule: Every Player slot must have a land path to at least three neutral settlements on the same landmass before navigation; otherwise reject seed.

state_transition_closures.title: Neutral recovery tick
state_transition_closures.rule: Every 72h neutral tick, after possible growth, resets neutral garrison to 100*L^2 and walls to max HP.

state_transition_closures.title: Inactive Player to neutral
state_transition_closures.rule: On conversion, troops dissolve and every resulting neutral gets canonical garrison 100*L^2 immediately; wall HP follows neutral conversion rule.

state_transition_closures.title: Intelligence exactness
state_transition_closures.rule: Detection detail uses deterministic intel_points and fixed error bands; Counterintelligence can reduce detail but never suppress an existing detection event.

state_transition_closures.title: Siege research exactness
state_transition_closures.rule: Cart Resilience=+5% HP/level; Coordination=+2% CONQUEST march cap/level; Advanced Siege=+3% wall_damage/level; Siege Logistics uses explicit capacity-cost formula.

state_transition_closures.title: How normal war ends
state_transition_closures.rule: Normal war is indefinite until bilateral peace; accepted peace enters PEACE_PENDING 12h, blocks new hostile launches, lets in-flight marches resolve, then becomes NEUTRAL.

state_transition_closures.title: Alliance role permissions
state_transition_closures.rule: Leader/Vice/Diplomat/Member permissions are explicit in CANONICAL_SPEC; no endpoint may infer extra permissions.

state_transition_closures.title: Mercenary completion
state_transition_closures.rule: Accepted contract cannot be voluntarily canceled; natural expiry or target dissolution is success; provider dissolution is failure/refund; 100% escrow goes to provider Emerald treasury.

state_transition_closures.title: Pyramid Guardian troop count
state_transition_closures.rule: Guardian target power converts to N using fixed 45/35/20 Infantry/Archer/Cavalry reference power and deterministic rounding.

state_transition_closures.title: Pyramid garrison lifecycle
state_transition_closures.rule: Winning survivors become garrison; allied real reinforcements allowed to cap; REWARD_LOCK returns living troops; each new OPEN creates a new Guardian snapshot.

state_transition_closures.title: Mission origin and concurrency
state_transition_closures.rule: Player chooses origin; max two total and max one same type; cooldown begins at completion; missions cannot be canceled.

state_transition_closures.title: Mission origin conquered
state_transition_closures.rule: Mission continues; completion routes troops/reward to current Mother or nearest own settlement; eliminated Player gets no reward and troops disband.

state_transition_closures.title: Predator Hunt orphan achievement
state_transition_closures.rule: Caccia ai predoni grants its production reward and +25 prestige only; no undefined achievement progress.

state_transition_closures.title: Mission reward snapshot
state_transition_closures.rule: Production-equivalent mission reward snapshots local production at mission start.

state_transition_closures.title: Mother loss with inflight marches
state_transition_closures.rule: Existing marches continue; returns route to new Mother/nearest own settlement; eliminated Player residual units disband at resolution.

state_transition_closures.title: Inactivity while attacks are inflight
state_transition_closures.rule: Conversion is serialized; arrivals revalidate new owner and legality, becoming PvE only if still legal; no phantom attacks.

state_transition_closures.title: Sanctuary/Unicorn and Mother loss
state_transition_closures.rule: Sanctuary is player-wide and follows Mother succession; in-progress upgrade continues; World elimination cancels sanctuary/ritual/Unicorn without refund or transfer.

state_transition_closures.title: Same-timestamp events
state_transition_closures.rule: Scheduled events use (scheduled_at,event_priority,event_id) and fixed type priorities; worker race cannot change outcome.

state_transition_closures.title: Castle visual growth
state_transition_closures.rule: Visual castle stages and footprints are fixed by level but remain rendering-only; logical anchor remains one tile and never changes ownership/pathfinding.

Orso.note: Bear wall_damage=40 per unit remains a separate siege-wall-damage stat.

early_game_fast.snapshot_rule: Eligibility and multipliers are frozen at job start; later acquisition of a fourth settlement does not modify an already-started eligible job.

prestige_sources.mission_catalog: Use exact prestige values from missions.catalog.

sentinel_runtime.regarrison_at_deadline: EXPIRY_FIRST; reject as target missing and route march by existing invalid-destination rule
sentinel_runtime.expiry_action: Remove sentinel and exclusively supported sector tiles atomically; keep tiles supported by other valid sectors; do not remove settlement anchors. Cancel expiry by generation check if superseded.
sentinel_runtime.post_conquest: Transferred empty sentinel starts a fresh 24h grace at owner change; old garrisons return under existing rules.
sentinel_runtime.garrison_combat: Use troop resolver without wall phase or settlement wall bonuses. Ordinary attacker victory removes defending garrison; it does not transfer the sentinel to attacker.
sentinel_runtime.capture_during_build: Cancel old-owner construction with no resource refund; no structure granted to old owner.
